issue.title: Verification using After and ArgumentCaptor with Times or AtLeast methods returns unexpected size of captured values list.
issue.body:
Hi!
I was looking issue #345 and found that the test "shouldReturnListOfArgumentsWithSameSizeAsGivenInAtMostVerification" (located in VerificationAfterDelayTest.java) fails if you use atLeast() or times() instead of atMost().
I created these tests:

![screenshot from 2016-03-24 16 50 29](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/17257307/14034443/8a3d8b98-f1e0-11e5-856a-65dc20a4fa6b.png)

input.args: Issue 379: after() with ArgumentCaptor and times()/atLeast() returns more captured values than expected. Evidence: VerificationOverTimeImpl.verify polls delegate.verify repeatedly, and CapturingMatcher.captureFrom appends on every match. Related: 345 (same problem, atMost), 1037 (duplicate captures).
